context.transcript:
I'd like to start today's session by introducing our most unique exhibit, our rooftop sculpture garden.
Every now and then you'll be assigned this tour, so you'll need to become familiar with the sculptures on our roof.
Here, let me pass around a fact sheet with information on each sculpture.
Now, museum visitors need to buy a special pass to see this exhibit, so please remember to collect all passes before you start the tour.
context.transcript_translation:
我想从介绍我们最独特的展品，我们的屋顶雕塑花园开始今天的环节。
时不时你会被分配到这次参观，所以你需要熟悉我们在屋顶的雕塑。
在这里，让我分发一份包含每件雕塑信息的资料表。
现在，博物馆访客需要购买一张特别通行证才能看到这个展览，所以请记住在开始参观前收集所有通行证。
